name: Keres
long_description: Keres (KAIR-eez) builds reusable unmanned jet interceptors for air defense. The Garmur launches on cue, closes at jet speed, positively identifies and kills drones and cruise missiles, then lands to fly again. It gives commanders a fighter-class response at a fraction of the cost.
one_liner: Kill the drone, keep the jet. Reusable unmanned interceptors.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Founder & CEO at Keres (YC F26). Previously served 11 years as a USAF pilot, including F-16 and U-28A Evaluator Pilot roles. Led cadet training operations at HQ AFROTC. Currently IMA to NORAD J3 in the Air Force Reserve. Educated at the U.S. Air Force Academy and École de l'air et de l'espace.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder/CTO at Keres (YC F26). Previously Head of Operations at H3X Technologies. Spent 4+ years at Boom Supersonic, rising from Aircraft Technician to Director of Aircraft and Production Operations for the XB-1 supersonic demonstrator. Led avionics, flight test, and manufacturing. BS in Mechanical Engineering from Oakland University.
